title: Firewall zones policy textarea UX hardening
acceptance_criteria: Zones policy textarea enforces `FROM_ZONE:FIREWALL_NAME` format per non-empty line.
Zones create/edit forms reject duplicate from-zone mappings before API submission.
Zones create/edit forms block save when policy textarea contains malformed lines.
Zones form helper text explicitly documents one mapping per from-zone and `LOCAL` support.
Frontend typecheck/build/runtime smoke pass after the UI validation changes.
assumptions: Most operator policy-entry mistakes are line format or duplicate from-zone errors and should be caught in UI before backend rejection.
UI validation should align with backend cross-zone constraints without changing existing API contracts.
Browser e2e smoke remains out-of-gate on this host until Playwright shared libraries are installed.

tasks.notes: Added strict policy textarea parser and pre-submit validation for malformed/duplicate mappings.
Validated via frontend gates (`tsc`, `build`, `smoke:runtime`) after UI parser changes.

commands.test: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false && npm run -s build && npm run -s smoke:runtime
